[[Lyssa's Bedlam]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Acolyte of Lyssa]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sunward Marches]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Scythe Mastery]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elegant Scythe]], [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Pathfinder Alon]] or [[Blonk]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*Perfect [[Scythe Grip]] of Scythe Mastery
*White [[dye]]
